notes: A spell opens when the Research Hut reaches unlockHutLevel; that is spell level 1, and each hut level after it is one spell level more, up to the length of power. radius is in battle units (100 = one cell). durationTicks is in battle ticks (10 = one second). power, by spell level: damage and heal = HP per pulse; freeze = percent of durationTicks the targets stay frozen; boost = percent more damage for durationTicks.

spells.description: Burning embers fall on enemy buildings and guards in the ring.
A healing mist mends your heroes and troops in the ring.
Towers and guards in the ring are frozen and cannot act.
Your heroes and troops in the ring hit harder for a while.
